assumption: Points and miles counted at 1¢ each (what Chase, Amex, Capital One and Bilt points are worth as cash or in the issuer's travel portal without a boost). Travel transfers can be worth more; we don't assume it. Credits and perks are not counted, because their value depends on whether you'd spend that money anyway.
